name: make-maths-pdf
title_zh: 一份自带引用的 LaTeX 数学讲义
tagline_zh: 几十个分支对话散落各处，它按完整信息深度重排成自包含项目，自动补引用、可再编译。新聊天进来只做定点改写，不推倒重来。
tagline_en: Dozens of branched chats collapse into one self-contained, cited LaTeX project. New logs merge via targeted.
desc_en: Build and revise self-contained, cited LaTeX mathematics projects from complete ChatGPT transcript corpora in PDF, Markdown, or other readable formats. Use explicitly to synthesize overlapping or branched chats at full informational depth, integrate new chats into existing material with targeted rewriting, or make small reader-driven refinements; compile with pdflatex and keep project files togeth
why_zh: 它把 ChatGPT 对话语料当原始素材而非笔记，保留重叠与分支的完整信息深度。
why_en: Treats chat corpora as source material, not notes—preserving full depth across overlaps and branches, then compiles into a.
limit_zh: 只认 LaTeX 数学工程，输出到 PDF/Markdown 为止；需本机装 pdflatex。
limit_en: LaTeX math projects only; outputs stop at PDF/Markdown. Needs local pdflatex and files kept in one folder. No Word/HTML, no non-math content.
title_en: A LaTeX math PDF built from your full ChatGPT chat history
